question: Which roles as charioteer of beings and ash-recliner are attributed to the deity in obeisance?
premises: The deity is addressed as the charioteer of the vehicle of beings.
The deity is addressed as reclining on ash.
Obeisance is offered to these aspects.
inference: The deity is honored as guide of beings and as one who rests on sacred ash.
plain_english: Obeisance to the charioteer of the vehicle of beings; obeisance to the one reclining on ash.
